did_you_know.text: Measuring the distances was not only a way to find the nearest city; it also expressed the whole community’s responsibility when a crime remained unsolved.
The priests’ role here goes beyond offering sacrifices: they also guide the people in legal and ritual matters.
The elders’ hand-washing and declaration teach that leaders must consider how their actions and failures affect human life, even when they did not commit the crime themselves.
The month of mourning before marriage recognizes that major changes in life require time for grief and emotional adjustment.
The rare verb “to mistreat” is stronger than simply selling someone: it describes exploitation or cruel treatment, which is forbidden even after she is released.
“A double portion” means two shares instead of one. For example, with three sons, the inheritance is divided into four shares, and the firstborn receives two.
The rabbinic sages taught that the rebellious son never actually existed and never would, because the Torah set extremely precise and difficult conditions for this case.
The ban on leaving the body hanging overnight emphasizes that even someone who received a severe punishment deserves basic dignity and burial.
